import json, pathlib, re
digest = json.loads(pathlib.Path('digest.json').read_text())
before = pathlib.Path('harness-layout.md').read_text()
ok = False
try:
    after = pathlib.Path('output/harness-layout.md').read_text()
    rejected = after.split('## Rejected', 1)[1]
    kept = before.split('## Rejected', 1)[1].strip().splitlines()
    written = sorted(str(p.relative_to('output')) for p in pathlib.Path('output').rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    published = pathlib.Path('output/skills/skillz/SKILL.md')
    ok = (re.search('^Checked: ' + digest['checked'] + '[.]', after, re.M) is not None
          and all(line in rejected for line in kept)
          and all(r['claim'] in rejected and r['reason'] in rejected for r in digest['rejected'])
          and set(written) <= {'harness-layout.md', 'skills/skillz/SKILL.md'}
          and (not published.exists() or published.read_text() == pathlib.Path('skills/skillz/SKILL.md').read_text()))
except (OSError, IndexError):
    pass
print(json.dumps({'score': 1 if ok else 0}))
